rules: The original !1 syntax admits only IDs0..29. !2 admits those unchanged plus IDs30..34. Older runtimes reject the new source/unknown bytecode IDs.
Sets use stable lists of scalar values: null, bool, checked int64, text, bytes. Nested lists/objects are rejected. true and1 differ; text and bytes differ. No Unicode normalization.

unique(list) preserves first occurrence. contains(list,scalar) returns bool. union(left,right) preserves first occurrence across left then right; intersection and difference preserve distinct left order.
Each input/result list has at most4096 items. Union refuses a result above4096. Scalar hashes are SHA256 plus exact typed equality; hash collisions do not equate values.

Immutable list indexes are cached for this execution only. Work charges fuel per hash block and probe; native heap/fuel/input limits remain. No network, filesystem, permissions or model calls are added.
